_comment: Agent-level scenarios on the synthetic baseline mailbox (indexer/tests/baseline/corpus.py). Each names the tools an agent should reach for first (expected_tools, alternatives), a call budget (max_calls) and one golden question in tests/baseline/golden.json: golden_search inherits that question's required_evidence and filters (as expected arguments), golden_enumerate its args and expected messages, golden_unanswerable makes the scenario expect abstention. required_citations (golden_search only) lists message refs the answer must cite: the correcting reply for a correction, each side for conflicting sources. held_out must equal tests/agent_metrics.py is_held_out(id); held-out scenarios are never used to tune anything. Scored by tests/agent_metrics.py; tests/test_agent_eval.py checks the reference traces in agent_reference_traces.json against them. Synthetic data only.
